raw:
VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the agent claims all 64 tests pass and describes a specific fix (Redis-backed dedupe guard), there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The absence of CI logs is particularly critical for a test-passing criterion. Self-reports are the weakest admissibility class and cannot establish objective facts like "all 64 tests pass" without supporting documentation.
